# Flying a kite in strong wind

## How The Kite Flies

Strong wind is fun — and risky. We tested kites, boats and bikes on the beach.
She called it "the plan". The team said "it was a game changer" afterwards.
We built 3 kites and the 2nd one broke. 12 kites flew on the last day.
Sales rose 40 percent and the round raised $2.5 million on March 12th.
We sold 4k kites by 10 a.m. sharp. Kitekit made it easy, a real game changer.
Send an e-mail to the team and utilize the checklist. Click here to read the [kite manual](https://example.com/manual?utm_source=news&id=7).
